claims.statement: The instrumentation records deterministic, internally-validated resource measurements.
limitations: overhead qualified only at depth-12 scale

claims.statement: A benchmark with a real adaptive-compute advantage exists (oracle beats best-fixed).
A learned controller routes causally and beats random/frozen/shuffled controls.
End-to-end routing (no privileged target, label-free capacity, no distillation) is learnable via REINFORCE under a binding budget.
limitations: surface cues present (route may ride surface signal)

claims.statement: When difficulty is a deep structural property (surface-matched), the route decision costs ~the expensive computation; cheap routing saves nothing.
claims.note: verdict ROUTE_DECISION_IS_THE_COMPUTATION; extends theory: V_realized = oracle_gap - route_decision_cost

claims.statement: On the synthetic substrate and conditional on a free exact halt oracle, halt-conditioned allocation beats input-blind allocation at an identical frozen operator-hop budget.
limitations: halt evaluations excluded from primary compute ledger

claims.statement: End-to-end task-loss routing via straight-through top-K (no oracle leak) is causal.
claims.note: credit-assignment collapse; superseded by CWC-L2a which shows REINFORCE recovers it -> the collapse was an estimator artifact

claims.statement: On the exact synthetic substrate, adaptive active-set allocation beats input-blind allocation when every successor observation, including terminal halt detection, is charged to the same frozen logical-lookup budget.
supporting_metrics: positive worst-seed effect in every cell
limitations: controller arithmetic and memory traffic unpriced
prohibited_extrapolations: physical FLOP latency or energy Pareto advantage

claims.statement: Role-conditioned functional reuse is a novel mechanism.
Under a hard parameter-cost budget, a context-conditioned plasticity allocation beats every fixed allocation (the metaplasticity oracle gap is real).

regime: learned reward-only governor recovers it out-of-sample

supporting_metrics: learned governor recovery 1.00 on held-out (8/8 controller seeds)
claims.note: Unbudgeted oracle gap ~0 (NOT_IDENTIFIABLE). EXPLORATORY revival at lambda~1 (seeds 0-4, post-hoc lambda) -> identifiability PILOT GO (artifacts/act-j-pilot-decision/) -> CONFIRMATORY run on 16 fresh held-out seeds with lambda frozen a priori: G_lo=0.111>0 at delta=0.05, present in every seed, controls pass (artifacts/wp3-plasticity-v2-confirmatory/). Confirms the ORACLE gap out-of-sample. L4a (artifacts/wp3-plasticity-v3-governor/): a reward-only REINFORCE governor recovers 100% of the gap on held-out seeds (8/8 controller inits), NULL falsifier at 0 -> the 'no learned governor' limitation is DISCHARGED in this given-context wide-margin regime. Still synthetic; does NOT touch L7.

claims.statement: Under inferred (noisy) context, the learned plasticity governor's realised value is bounded by I(C;Z): it tracks the master inequality's information discount and vanishes when the context cannot be cheaply inferred.
claims.note: plasticity analog of L2b (route-decision cost); instantiates V_realized <= oracle_gap - c_route and rational-inattention abstention at boundary p*~0.466

claims.statement: The learned governor's credit-assignment collapse margin is governed by the (sigma/Delta)^2 sample-complexity law (Delta* scales linearly with reward noise).
supporting_metrics: more noise gave better recovery at Delta=0.05
claims.note: FROZEN FALSIFICATION: a collapse is real but its noise-scaling is refuted -- REINFORCE advantage (r-baseline) scales with sigma, so step size grows with noise and cancels distinguishability. Possibly underpowered (8 seeds, 5-pt grid); NOT re-run to flip. Does not change L4/L4a/L4b.

claims.statement: The learned governor's credit-assignment collapse margin follows the (sigma/Delta)^2 sample-complexity law in the episode budget (Delta* ~ 1/sqrt(N)) and in noise.
claims.note: Higher-power revisit of L4c. Budget-scaling is DIRECTIONALLY real (monotone power law) but STEEPER than 1/sqrt(N) -> misses a-priori band [0.25,0.55] on the low side; noise axis robustly ANTI-scales (more noise -> smaller margin, exploration). The (sigma/Delta)^2 law governs NEITHER axis. Instrument-range grid amendment disclosed in prereg. Does not change L4/L4a/L4b/L4c.

claims.statement: The governor's collapse-margin budget scaling is a pure 2-arm logit-dynamics phenomenon (a 2-arm ablation reproduces both the exponent and the noise sign).
claims.note: PARTIAL explanation: noise-as-exploration IS a 2-arm effect (ratio<1 reproduced), but the budget exponent is NOT pure 2-arm -- the 2-arm limit is drift-limited (-1.12, confirming dg/dt~LR*Delta*pi(1-pi)) while the full 4-arm governor is -0.654; dead-arm suppression injects diffusion. Hypothesis 'collapse is 2-arm' falsified; truer picture = drift-limited-2-arm + 4-arm dilution. Grid amendment disclosed. Does not change L4/L4a/L4b/L4c/L4d.

claims.statement: The governor's collapse-margin budget exponent shallows monotonically as the number of arms grows (dead arms inject diffusion).
limitations: asymptote overshoots -0.5 toward 0 (dead arms progressively kill budget-scaling, not just diffusion)
exact exponents grid-sensitive; monotone direction robust
claims.note: Closes L4e: the collapse exponent depends monotonically on arm count. Mechanistic chain: 2-arm REINFORCE is drift-limited (N^-1); adding dead arms dilutes b-vs-r mass and shallows the exponent past diffusion. Explains why the (sigma/Delta)^2 law (L4c/L4d) fails at K>=3.

claims.statement: The L4 cost-budget oracle gap and governor recovery are robust to the cost model (survive monotone cost transforms).
limitations: gap magnitude is cost-shape dependent (log compresses to 0.035)
claims.note: Validity check: monotone transforms preserve the cost ORDERING (head<attn<mlp) that makes the interaction real, so identifiability survives; magnitude varies. Strengthens L4.

claims.statement: Identifiability and governor recovery generalize to more contexts at constant per-context budget (contexts do not interfere).
limitations: matched per-context budget (no dilution tested here)
claims.note: G_lo GROWS with contexts (more valuable conditioning + tighter sqrt|C|); governor holds at matched per-context budget. Generalizes the 2-context L4/L4a result.

Compute-equivalent Pareto advantage vs MoD/MoE on real workloads.
claims.note: the decisive next step; requires cloud scale + strong baselines
